module: Node "AI Path from File" (category provider, color ai). Provides a ScriptAI path loaded from a track file /replays/scriptai/tracks/*.track.json chosen in the inspector ("Refresh Files" button to relist). Output: path (type aiPath), this is the "recording" field of the file. To be connected to "AI Follow Path from Data".
notes: If no file is chosen or if reading fails, loadedFile stays nil and work raises an error (loadedFile.recording).
jsonReadFile receives the first return value of mgr:getRelativeAbsolutePath (the resolved path).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

init.desc: Lists the track files (FS:findFiles) and initializes the name and loaded file.

drawCustomProperties.desc: Draws the "Refresh Files" button and the dropdown list of track files.

work.desc: Loads the file with jsonReadFile if it is not loaded yet and publishes loadedFile.recording on path.

drawMiddle.desc: Displays the short file name and its loading state.

_onDeserialized.desc: Restores the file name and recomputes the short name.
